artworks.title: Un jour ou l'on ne paye pas
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded art gallery scene. The image features a gathering of individuals in a confined space, many of whom are interacting with or observing paintings on the walls in the background. The individuals are depicted with varied expressions and exaggerated features. The attire suggests a past era, with men in high top hats and women in bonnets. The crowded space implies a sense of excitement or urgency. The text at the bottom of the image translates to "A day when one does not pay... Twenty-five degrees of heat."

artworks.title: Maniére d'entrainer les cosaques
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of grotesque figures riding horses. The figures are depicted with exaggerated facial features and wild hair, riding galloping horses while carrying long, thin items. The horses are also drawn in an exaggerated style, with detailed musculature, conveying a sense of speed and motion.

artworks.title: Artistes en train d'examiner ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals in a museum or gallery-like setting, closely examining artwork displayed on the walls. The individuals are standing and leaning slightly forward with an intent focus on the art. The main figure in the foreground has long dark hair and a large, pronounced nose, wearing a large hat. Another figure with a sharply pointed beard looks intently at the artwork. They are dressed in dark clothing typical of 19th-century fashion, with jackets and hats. The background is filled with framed paintings lining the walls, with indistinct or blurred art subjects visible within them. The setting suggests an exhibition space typical of the period's art salons.

artworks.title: Le déjeuner du patron le sixiéme clerc ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of dining scenes labeled as "Le déjeuner du patron" and "Le sixième clerc prenant sa pitance". The upper scene depicts a well-fed supervisor or boss enjoying a meal at a table, with a large carafe and a bottle present. The lower scene contrasts this with an emaciated figure hungrily consuming a small portion of food with enthusiasm. The drawing captures a juxtaposition between the two characters' meals, emphasizing social or economic disparities. The setting in both scenes appears to be an interior, with simple furnishings and décor.

artworks.title: Tiens, papa, te v'la! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows several people seen from the waist up, standing close together in a crowded setting. In the center, there is an older man with distinct facial features, wearing a tall top hat and a long coat. Beside him is a woman with a rounded face, wearing a bonnet and a coat. With them is a child with a small hat, long hair in braids, and a plaid scarf pointing at the man. On the right side, another man with a bald, rounded head and a large nose looks to the side engaged in conversation with the central man. The background is filled with a crowd of other people wearing hats, and includes the outline of arches, suggesting this is a public exhibition or salon. Above the scene, the words "LE PUBLIC DU SALON" are printed.

artworks.title: Quand sonnent quatre heures
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals from the waist up, standing close together in a crowded scene with exaggerated facial expressions. The people have various mustaches and sideburns, wear tall black hats, and formal dark suits. They carry umbrellas and walking sticks. The background is lightly sketched, possibly depicting a public event or salon, as suggested by the visual title "LE PUBLIC DU SALON."

artworks.title: Oui, Mossieu Fremouillet, tout va de mal en pis ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are depicted in a social setting. The first man is seated with his left arm on a table, his right knee resting on his crossed left leg. He has a rounded face, a prominent chin, curly short hair, and a serious expression. He wears a long coat, a patterned shirt and pants, and a bow tie. The second man is standing and leaning slightly towards the seated man, with his right elbow on the table. He has a narrow face, balding hair, and wears a long dark overcoat, trousers, a high collared shirt, and a waistcoat. In the background, there is a textured wall with various shapes and symbols, along with a table holding a hanging pot. The image is monochromatic in a sketch-like style.

artworks.title: Les alliés s'appretent a pousser les opérations ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a dimly lit room. The central figure stands facing right, looking at a piece of paper. They are wearing an elaborate hat with a long tassel, an oversized shirt, fitted pants, and are barefoot. A small candle on a table illuminates the room. Another figure to the left observes the scene, wearing a high-collared, tightly fitted garment. The image is in grayscale, with detailed crosshatching for texture.

artworks.title: Paris enrhume
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures in winter attire. The figures are wearing exaggerated clothing such as high top hats and heavy scarves. Some figures appear to be walking briskly. The central figures have exaggerated facial features and elongated bodies. The background text is faint. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of works by Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Ce qui nous prouve ... que ce colosse ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large inflated figure hovering above a field of bayonets. The figure is labeled "COLOSSE DU NORD" (Colossus of the North) and has exaggerated features typical of caricature art. The figure appears to be losing stability and air rapidly. Below the figure are many sharp bayonets pointed upward. In the background, there are depictions of fortifications or buildings and bursts of smoke.

artworks.title: Sébastopol
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of chaos unfolding at a dining table. The scene shows dishes and utensils scattered as an explosion erupts from the center. Two men are seen with shocked expressions, reacting to the sudden event. The background features a night sky with what might be interpreted as smoke or debris, emphasizing the chaos. The drawing style combines caricature and political commentary, reminiscent of 19th-century satire.

artworks.title: L'empereur Nicolas recevant une députation ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a comical military figure and a group of animals in attire. The central figure wears a helmet and armor, gesturing commandingly. The other characters are dog-like creatures in similar attire, following suit. The drawing features fine lines and cross-hatching, emphasizing the comedic and critical tone. The animals are anthropomorphic in posture and expression. The piece is a political satire, as indicated by the text on the print.

artworks.title: Le roi des grecs ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two uniformed figures in an exaggerated and satirical pose. The image depicts a scene with two figures interacting. One figure is holding a rifle with a crown on top and wearing a military uniform, looking forlorn. The other figure is dressed in elaborate ceremonial armor with an eagle helmet, gesturing as if explaining something. This figure wears boots with spurs and is in a dynamic posture. In the background, there is another figure standing passively in traditional attire. The drawing features bold, linear strokes and strong contrasts.

artworks.title: Un terrible cauchemar
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a large sleeping figure with small dancing figures on its stomach. The scene shows a person asleep on a bed or couch, with eyes closed and hand resting on their side. Their head is covered with a hat. The small figures are dancing on the larger figure's stomach in a lively manner. The figures appear to be wearing costumes, hinting at a theatrical or circus setting. The drawing is characterized by expressive lines conveying a dreamlike and humorous quality.

artworks.title: Le soldat...Je sais...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in confrontation against a backdrop of clouds. One figure is hunched and ragged with a pointed hat, carrying a sack, while the other is robed and bearded, wearing a tall hat. The drawing is detailed, focusing on the exaggerated features of the two figures. The composition shows the hunched figure on the left appearing to be in conversation with the full-robed figure on the right. The background includes simple cloud formations sketched in minimalistic lines. The bottom of the image includes text, which appears to be dialogue between the two figures. This is in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: La fonte d'un colosse de neige
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large melting snow figure with onlookers below. The image depicts a colossal snow or ice structure that appears to be melting, as illustrated by the water droplets drizzling from it. The structure has an exaggerated form, resembling a misshapen or abstract figure. The melted figure is towering above the ground where several seated observers encircle it. The composition suggests movement as the snow entity transitions, enhancing the dynamic interaction between the structure and the seated figures. The background includes minimalistic elements, concentrating the viewer's attention on the central event. The style of the illustration is characteristic of the 19th-century print and drawing tradition, focusing more on contrast and outline to convey detail and texture.

artworks.title: Est-ce le garçon?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a restaurant. The image features two individuals seated at a table with tableware and a standing figure to their left. Behind them, other figures are seated, suggesting the setting of a busy dining establishment. The standing figure is dressed formally. The room is depicted with sketchy lines that hint at wall decorations and furnishings such as a coat rack holding a coat and hat. The style of drawing is characterized by its monochromatic tones and caricatured forms.

artworks.title: Croquis pris aux Champs Elysées
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts twisting and curving lines that form abstract shapes resembling tree trunks, branches, and humanoid figures. The branches appear to merge with the figures, creating a blend of natural and unusual elements. The figures wear elongated hats and seem integrated into the branches against a tranquil landscape.

artworks.title: Une lecture intéressante et rafraichissante
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated outdoors near a body of water with their feet submerged. Both individuals are seen from head to toe. The person on the left is seated with a slightly hunched posture, reading a document or a book. They have a balding head, wear glasses, a dark suit with the coat draped over their knees, and a top hat placed on the ground. The individual on the right is sitting upright with a scarf over their hair. They wear a long dress with a shawl, and their hands rest on their lap. The background features a bare tree and a rough, sketched environment. The sky and landscape are depicted in shades of light and dark.

artworks.title: C'est bien décidé ... Je ne chasserai plus avec vous! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in a sketch style drawing. The first person on the left is shown in profile, seated with his full body visible. He has a long, thin face with pronounced features and messy hair. He wears a dark jacket and pants with boots, sitting on the ground with knees bent and arms resting on them. The second person stands in the center, facing the seated man. His body is visible from the knees up. He has curly hair visible under a cap, and his facial features are rounder. He wears a checkered coat with a button-up front and high boots. His arms are crossed, and he has a round bag hanging at his side. The third person is seated on the ground to the right, visible mostly from the side. He holds a long stick or gun upright in both hands, resting on one knee. He wears a cap and has a partially obscured face with a large coat and boots. The background is minimal, composed of simple lines indicating the ground and an abstract surface, suggesting an outdoor environment. Text is visible beneath the scene.

artworks.title: Toujours la heunesse-flourens
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted in the image. On the left, a woman is walking away from the viewer. She has her head turned to the side, with hair styled into a bun, wearing a dress with frills and a shawl. In the middle, a man is leaning forward, holding a monocle and a cane. He wears a suit, tie, and top hat. The man on the right stands with hands clasped behind his back, dressed similarly with a top hat, suit, and tie. The background shows a sketched architectural landscape with abstract lines suggesting movement or scenery.

artworks.title: A  Naples: Voyons, je lui fais grace ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image showing several figures in a state of commotion. The drawing depicts a scene where multiple individuals are engaged in a physical struggle or confrontation. In the center, two individuals are restraining another who appears anguished. A third figure is preparing to strike or involved in the action with a long stick. In the background, an authoritative figure is giving orders from a raised platform, with architectural elements like pillars visible behind them. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of a satirical or editorial illustration, with expressive and dynamic lines capturing a moment of tension and drama.

artworks.title: Ma chére, je vous apporte une potiche ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting over pots on a staircase landing. The drawing features a person climbing the stairs holding a pot, while another person stands at the top with another pot in hand. Detailed shading and lines create a sense of depth and texture in the folds of their clothing and the steps of the staircase. The setting appears to be indoor with intricate details on the railing to the left. The text above and below the image suggests a narrative element. The drawing style reflects a focus on line work and texture, capturing both the setting and the mood through shading and outline.

artworks.title: Toujours le livre de M. Flourens
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two elderly individuals engaging with each other indoors. One individual is holding an open book, appearing animated. The other individual, leaning towards them with interest, mirrors their expression. The room includes a birdcage and wall decorations, suggesting an intimate setting. The figures are exaggerated, emphasizing their interaction. Strong contrasts and dynamic lines convey a lively scene.
